system.name: TRIP
system.one_liner: TRIP is Votegral's in-person registration component that lets voters create real and fake voting credentials at a kiosk without trusting the hardware

content.subject: how a voter moves through check-in, credentialing, check-out, and activation stages, each in a different supervision/environment setting

elements.name: Check-In
elements.role: first stage heading: a supervised public environment

elements.name: Voter
elements.role: the person registering; walks through all four stages

elements.name: Official
elements.role: registration staff who authenticate the voter and later display a credential

elements.name: Authenticate
elements.role: the Check-In stage's action: the official verifies the voter's eligibility

elements.name: Check-In Ticket
elements.role: artifact handed to the voter at Check-In, admitting them to Credentialing

elements.name: Credentialing
elements.role: second stage heading: a supervised private environment where phones are barred

elements.name: Kiosk
elements.role: device the voter alone uses in the privacy booth to print credentials

elements.name: Create Credentials
elements.role: the Credentialing stage's action: printing one real and any fake credentials

elements.name: Credentials
elements.role: the printed credentials the voter carries out of Credentialing

elements.name: Check-Out
elements.role: third stage heading: back to a supervised environment

elements.name: Display A Credential
elements.role: the Check-Out stage's action: the voter shows a credential before leaving

elements.name: Credential Activation
elements.role: fourth stage heading: an unsupervised private environment

elements.name: Device
elements.role: the voter's own device on which a credential is later activated as real

elements.name: Activate Real Credential
elements.role: the final stage's action: privately marking which credential is genuine

relations.what: the voter authenticates with the official to receive a check-in ticket
the check-in ticket admits the voter to the privacy-booth kiosk
the kiosk creates real and fake paper credentials for the voter to carry out
the voter presents a credential for the official to display at check-out
the voter later activates a real credential on their own device

panels.label: Check-In
panels.differs: template/first frame: in a supervised public environment (dashed border), the Voter authenticates with an Official to receive a Check-In Ticket

panels.label: Credentialing
panels.differs: supervised private environment (bold solid border, phones barred); the voter uses a Kiosk alone to create real and fake Credentials

panels.label: Check-Out
panels.differs: back to a supervised environment (dashed border); the voter displays a credential to an Official before leaving

panels.label: Credential Activation
panels.differs: unsupervised private environment (dash-dot border); the voter activates a chosen credential as the real one on their own Device

content.key_idea: A voter's registration moves through four stages of decreasing supervision: public check-in, private kiosk credentialing (real and fake), supervised check-out display, then unsupervised activation of the real credential.
content.reading_order: left to right along the Time arrow through Check-In, Credentialing, Check-Out, and Credential Activation, reading each stage's icons above its action label

palette.used_for: light gray fill of the plain voter/pedestrian figures and desks
muted blue-gray fill of the Official/attendant figures, distinguishing staff from voters
deeper blue fill accenting the Device (phone) icon
medium gray fill of the Kiosk icon
pale blue-gray fill of the Check-In Ticket icon
very pale cyan fill of the Device's screen

style.stroke: black outlines throughout; each stage's frame border uses a different dash pattern (dashed, solid, or dash-dot) to encode its environment
style.arrows: a single bold black horizontal Time arrow runs beneath all four stages; small envelope icons mark artifacts (ticket, credentials) handed from one stage to the next
style.font: bold sans-serif stage headers; plain sans-serif action captions and legend text
style.icons: pictographic person silhouettes (voter, official), a kiosk icon, a red no-phone prohibition icon, an envelope icon for handed credentials, and a smartphone Device icon

encoding.color_means: blue-gray tints the Official/attendant figures to distinguish staff from the plain gray voter figures; blue also accents the Device icon
encoding.line_style_means: the frame border style is the key code: dashed = supervised public environment, solid = supervised private environment, dash-dot = unsupervised private environment
encoding.state_means: each of the four dashed/solid/dash-dot frames is one successive stage of the same voter's registration, arranged left to right along the Time arrow
encoding.emphasis: the Credentialing frame is drawn with a bold solid border and a red no-phone icon, marking it as the security-critical step where real and fake credentials are created
reusable_patterns: a left-to-right stage timeline where each frame's border line-style itself encodes a classification (here, supervision/privacy level), explained in a small legend below
weaknesses: the 'Voter' icon reappears unlabelled in later stages, so the reader must infer that the same generic gray figure represents the same voter throughout purely from position along the timeline

evidence: Registering to use Votegral involves the following main steps, which Fig. 1 illustrates at a high level
A registration official verifies each voter's eligibility, then gives the voter a check-in ticket
the voter (1) authenticates to an official at a check-in desk to obtain a check-in ticket

summary: Figure 1 lays out the TRIP voter-registration workflow within Votegral as four stages along a time arrow, each framed with a border style that encodes its supervision level. In Check-In (supervised public environment, dashed border), the Voter authenticates with an Official to get a Check-In Ticket. In Credentialing (supervised private environment, bold solid border, phones barred), the voter alone uses a Kiosk to create real and fake paper credentials. In Check-Out (dashed border again), the voter presents and an Official displays a credential before leaving. Finally, in Credential Activation (unsupervised private environment, dash-dot border), only later and without anyone watching, the voter activates whichever credential is the genuine one on their own Device.
summary_zh: 该图示TRIP注册流程沿时间轴分四阶段，边框样式标注监管级别：先公开监管下经Official认证领票；再私密监管下独自用Kiosk制作真假凭证；随后出示凭证签出；最后于无监管私密环境中在自己设备激活真凭证，隐私递增保障胁迫下可交出假凭证。
